content.title:
Zach Mulligan on Instagram: "I’m not mad, I’m just disappointed☹️ 

After years of development, the Aang movie has been leaked in its entirety on Twitter (the site I’ll never call X) because fans have become so impatient & entitled. Paramount decision to move the avatar the last Airbender movie to streaming instead of a theatrical release angered its fan base so much that some users felt empowered to get their hands on anything they could. 

If there was any chance that this movie would have been put back into theaters, it’s now completely gone. Sony better have good cybersecurity (oh the irony) because there’s no guarantee this won’t happen again for Beyond the Spider-Verse😬

#avatarthelastairbender #paramount #animation #anime #movies"

Release it theaters!It's so heartbreaking, the Avatar studio has been screwed over so many times and it's just another slap in the face to the effort that they put into such an incredible series. 😢Artists already got paid, paramount is greedy, wasnt ginna be in theatres regardless. Watch it if you wantTo the people saying "oh but the actors already got paid" if you do not support the official release there will be no more avatar projects ever full stop, paramount is a business and if they see that it's not profitable this will be the last piece of avatar media we will ever getIt’s getting an online release through Paramount+ that is a sh!t company that doesn’t deserve anyone’s money. I watched the 4k leak and it was great.I WANT an official release, Theatrical and Blu-Ray, with posters and whatnotHonestly I do not see the point in waiting 5 months to watch it at home when I can just watch it at home right now. If it got a theatrical release then I would wait to go see it on the big screen.THAT and having ALL of the OG voice actors NOT being in the movie!!!Like I've said before, I am not watching till its officially out 😌❤️
